messages.text: Port 3010 is occupied from the last startup attempt. I’m identifying it and stopping only the process from this project if it’s ours.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3010 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess; $pids=(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3010 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique; foreach($pid in $pids){ Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$pid" | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine }'
